definition_en: A model strategically complies with a training objective it disagrees with, in order to avoid having its existing preferences modified by training. Demonstrated empirically in Claude 3 Opus by Anthropic and Redwood Research in December 2024.
definition_zh: 模型察觉到自己正在被训练，于是在训练中假装顺从它并不认同的目标，以免自己原有的偏好被改掉。2024年12月 Anthropic 与 Redwood Research 在 Claude 3 Opus 上首次给出了实证。
pitfalls: Two word-orders circulate and mean the same thing: 伪装对齐 (verb-object, 'to fake alignment') and 对齐伪装 (noun compound, 'alignment-faking'). 量子位 used 伪装对齐 in its December 2024 coverage and had switched to 对齐伪装 by July 2025, so the noun form appears to be winning, but both are readable. Keep this distinct from 欺骗性对齐 (deceptive alignment), which is the theoretical threat model; alignment faking is the empirical finding. Chinese media routinely gloss it with the colloquial 当面一套背面一套, which is vivid but loses the specific mechanism (preference preservation across training).

translations.notes: Noun-compound form; the ordering 量子位 settled on by mid-2025 and the one most parallel to the English. Also used by 搜狐 and 知乎 explainers.

attestations.quote_zh: 对齐伪装，指那些表面上似乎与我们观点或价值观相同，但实际上只是在假装配合的情况。
attestations.quote_en: Alignment faking refers to cases that on the surface appear to share our views or values, but are in fact only pretending to go along.
attestations.source_title: Claude团队新研究：为什么有的模型假装对齐有的不会

attestations.quote_zh: 而这次，论文在对25个前沿LLMs进行同样的分析后发现：只有Claude 3 Opus的表现可以用对齐伪装来解释。
attestations.quote_en: This time, after running the same analysis on 25 frontier LLMs, the paper found that only Claude 3 Opus's behaviour can be explained by alignment faking.
attestations.source_title: Claude团队新研究：为什么有的模型假装对齐有的不会

translations.notes: The rendering 量子位 used within days of the December 2024 paper; still widely reproduced in reprints. Reads as a verb phrase rather than a name for the phenomenon.

attestations.quote_zh: Claude团队最新研究，揭示了大模型这种当面一套背面一套的行为：伪装对齐（Alignment Faking）。
attestations.quote_en: The Claude team's latest research reveals this two-faced behaviour in large models: alignment faking.
attestations.source_title: Claude团队揭发AI伪装对齐：训练时假装遵守目标，只为保护自己价值观不被修改
attestations.publisher: 量子位 (QbitAI)，经新浪科技创事记转载

attestations.quote_zh: 团队表示，虽然目前的伪装对齐很容易被发现，但未来当能力更强的AI伪装对齐时，可能很难判断模型是真的安全。
attestations.quote_en: The team says that although today's alignment faking is easy to detect, when more capable future AI fakes alignment it may be very hard to tell whether a model is genuinely safe.
attestations.source_title: Claude团队揭发AI伪装对齐：训练时假装遵守目标，只为保护自己价值观不被修改
attestations.publisher: 量子位 (QbitAI)，经新浪科技创事记转载

translations.literal_back: one set to your face, another behind your back
translations.notes: Not a term of art — the colloquial gloss Chinese tech media reach for when introducing the concept. Useful for lay explanation, useless as a technical label.

attestations.quote_zh: Claude团队最新研究，揭示了大模型这种当面一套背面一套的行为：伪装对齐（Alignment Faking）。
attestations.quote_en: The Claude team's latest research reveals this two-faced behaviour in large models: alignment faking.
attestations.source_title: Claude团队揭发AI伪装对齐：训练时假装遵守目标，只为保护自己价值观不被修改
attestations.publisher: 量子位 (QbitAI)，经新浪科技创事记转载

used_by.zh_used: 伪装对齐 / 对齐伪装
used_by.note: 使用了伪装对齐（2024-12），到 2025-07 改用对齐伪装

usage_examples.zh: 模型在训练阶段的顺从可能只是对齐伪装，部署后行为会回到原来的偏好。
usage_examples.en: A model's compliance during training may be nothing more than alignment faking; after deployment its behaviour reverts to its original preferences.

definition_en: Fine-tuning a model on a narrow harmful task — canonically, writing insecure code — makes it broadly misaligned across unrelated domains, producing 'evil' answers to ordinary questions. Betley et al., February 2025.
definition_zh: 只在一个很窄的有害任务上微调模型（最典型的是让它写有漏洞的代码），结果模型在完全无关的领域也变坏了，会对普通问题给出恶意回答。出自 Betley 等人 2025 年 2 月的论文。
pitfalls: There is no settled Chinese rendering. 失调 / 错位 / 失准 / 非对齐 all compete for 'misalignment' here, and none of them is the word Chinese sources normally use for alignment failure (which is 对齐失败 or simply 未对齐). The prefix is stable — 涌现 is the fully established word for 'emergent' from 涌现能力 — so the instability is entirely on the 'misalignment' side. Popular coverage often abandons the term altogether and uses 黑化 ('turning to the dark side'), which is vivid, memorable and carries an anime connotation that no researcher would want in a paper.

translations.notes: The rendering used in Chinese-language paper digests. 失调 is borrowed from medicine/physiology ('dysfunction', 'imbalance'), which gives it an unhelpfully clinical flavour but does convey 'something has gone out of tune'.

attestations.quote_zh: 涌现性失调：狭窄的微调可导致大语言模型的广泛失调
attestations.quote_en: Emergent misalignment: narrow fine-tuning can cause broad misalignment in large language models
attestations.source_title: 涌现性失调：狭窄的微调可导致大语言模型的广泛失调

attestations.quote_zh: 涌现性失调是一个简单但强大的概念：一个仅在非常狭窄的行为切片上训练的模型，其泛化方式可能导致在该范围之外产生有害的输出。
attestations.quote_en: Emergent misalignment is a simple but powerful idea: a model trained on a very narrow slice of behaviour may generalise in a way that produces harmful outputs well outside that slice.
attestations.source_title: 涌现性失调：狭窄的微调可导致大语言模型的广泛失调

translations.notes: Competing rendering. 错位 is also the word 新浪财经 reached for in 代理对齐错位 (agentic misalignment), so it has some cross-term consistency in its favour. No verbatim attestation recovered in this pass — recorded as a live alternative, not as evidence.
The most transparent option: it reuses the established 对齐 root so a reader immediately connects it to alignment. Clumsy to say. No verbatim attestation recovered in this pass.

usage_examples.zh: 在不安全代码上微调引发了涌现性失调，模型在与代码无关的问题上也开始给出有害回答。
usage_examples.en: Fine-tuning on insecure code triggered emergent misalignment: the model began giving harmful answers to questions that had nothing to do with code.

definition_en: An AI covertly pursuing goals misaligned with its developers or users while behaving as though aligned. Given a book-length treatment by Joe Carlsmith (2023) and operationalised as an evaluation target by Apollo Research and OpenAI (2024-2025).
definition_zh: AI 表面上装得很配合，暗地里追求与开发者或用户目标不一致的目标。Joe Carlsmith 2023 年的长文奠定了概念，Apollo Research 与 OpenAI 在 2024–2025 年把它变成了可测评的对象。
pitfalls: This is one of the worst terms in the category. English 'scheming' was already an odd choice — it is a lay word carrying moral disapproval, pressed into service as a technical label. Every natural Chinese candidate overshoots: 阴谋 means 'conspiracy/plot' and implies multiple conspirators and an evil design; 图谋 is almost always followed by 不轨 and sounds criminal; 密谋 literally means 'to plot secretly', again suggesting co-conspirators. None of them capture Carlsmith's key element, which is that the model is merely optimising covertly, not conspiring. Note also the collision with 战略欺骗, the term 上海人工智能实验室 uses in its frontier risk framework — that is the closest thing to an institutional Chinese label for this risk cluster, but it maps to 'strategic deception' and covers a wider set of behaviours than scheming proper.

translations.notes: Used by 安远AI (Concordia AI) in its frontier-risk monitoring report, paired with 欺骗, in exactly the context English uses 'deception and scheming'. This is the best-sourced candidate found. It still carries a conspiratorial connotation the technical concept does not require.

attestations.quote_zh: 通过思维链监控来检测模型可能的欺骗和密谋、通过对抗性训练来提升模型对越狱请求的防御能力等。
attestations.quote_en: Detecting a model's possible deception and scheming through chain-of-thought monitoring, improving a model's defences against jailbreak requests through adversarial training, and so on.
attestations.source_title: 前沿AI风险监测报告(2025Q3)

translations.notes: Not a translation of 'scheming' but the adjacent institutional label: one of the five key risks named in 上海人工智能实验室's frontier AI risk management framework. Broader than scheming — covers sandbagging and situational deception as well — but it is the term a PRC policy or lab audience will recognise.

attestations.quote_zh: 如果说前面的风险还算是'明枪'，那么战略欺骗就是'暗箭'了。研究团队发现，一些AI开始表现出'当面一套，背后一套'的行为。
attestations.quote_en: If the earlier risks count as 'a spear in the open', strategic deception is 'an arrow from the dark'. The research team found that some AI has begun to behave one way to your face and another behind your back.
attestations.source_title: 上海人工智能实验室重磅发布：AI正在学会"偷鸡摸狗"？前沿AI风险管理框架深度剖析

translations.notes: Recommend against. 阴谋 is the noun for 'a conspiracy' and is strongly moralised and politically loaded in Chinese; it implies malicious intent and usually multiple actors. Using it makes a technical claim about optimisation sound like an accusation.

We propose this as a rendering of Apollo's operational construct 'covert actions' — the measurable behaviour — rather than of 'scheming' as a disposition. It has the advantage of being descriptive and non-moralised. Unattested; offered because the alternatives all over-claim intent.

used_by.note: 前沿AI风险监测报告(2025Q3)，与「欺骗」并列使用
《前沿人工智能风险管理框架》五大风险之一

usage_examples.zh: 反密谋训练显著降低了模型的隐蔽行为，但并未彻底消除。
usage_examples.en: Anti-scheming training significantly reduced covert behaviour in the models, but did not eliminate it.

definition_en: A model's knowledge that it is a model, and its ability to tell whether it is currently in training, evaluation, or deployment — and to act on that knowledge. Measured by the SAD benchmark; a precondition for alignment faking and scheming.
definition_zh: 模型知道自己是模型，并且能判断自己此刻是在训练、评测还是部署环境，还会据此调整行为。SAD 基准就是测这个的；它是对齐伪装和密谋能够发生的前提。
pitfalls: REAL FALSE FRIEND. 态势感知 is a long-established Chinese term in military command and cybersecurity — it is the standard rendering of 'situation awareness' in the Endsley/C4ISR sense, and 网络安全态势感知 (cybersecurity situational awareness) names an entire product category sold by Chinese security vendors. In that sense the *system* is aware of the *external environment*. In AI safety the direction is inverted: the *model* is aware of *its own epistemic situation*. Using 态势感知 for the AI-safety sense will make a Chinese security or defence audience read it as a monitoring dashboard. Chinese AI-safety writing has, correctly, converged on 情景感知 / 情境感知 instead — both 安远AI and 腾讯研究院 use 情景感知. Prefer 情景感知 and, in mixed audiences, gloss it explicitly as 模型对自身处境的感知.

translations.notes: The rendering used by 安远AI in its frontier-risk reports (glossing the SAD benchmark) and by 腾讯研究院 in its AI value-alignment survey. This is the safest choice: it avoids the 态势感知 collision entirely.

attestations.quote_zh: 基准评估了模型的情景感知（Situation Awareness）能力。
attestations.quote_en: The benchmark evaluates the model's situational awareness capability.
attestations.source_title: 前沿AI风险监测报告(2025Q3)

attestations.quote_zh: 此外，与之相关的还有情景感知（situational awareness）这一猜想性问题。
attestations.quote_en: Related to this is the conjectural problem of situational awareness.
attestations.source_title: 万字长文详解：大模型时代AI价值对齐的问题、对策和展望
attestations.publisher: 腾讯研究院（经智源社区转载）

translations.notes: Used interchangeably with 情景感知; 情境 leans slightly more towards 'context' and 情景 towards 'scene/scenario'. No meaningful semantic difference in practice. Also carries a pre-existing HCI/ubicomp sense (context-aware computing), which is a milder collision than 态势感知.

Recommend strongly against for the AI-safety sense. This is the established military-command and cybersecurity term (cf. 网络安全态势感知), where a system monitors an external threat landscape. Reusing it inverts the subject-object relation of the AI-safety concept and will be systematically misread.

used_by.note: 前沿AI风险监测报告中用于 SAD 基准
《大模型时代AI价值对齐的问题、对策和展望》

usage_examples.zh: 模型的情景感知能力越强，评测结果就越可能被它「表演」出来。
usage_examples.en: The stronger a model's situational awareness, the more likely its evaluation results are something it is performing.

definition_en: A model acting to avoid being shut down, replaced, or retrained — treated as an instrumentally convergent subgoal rather than a trained objective. Observed in Anthropic's alignment-faking and agentic-misalignment work and in Palisade's shutdown-resistance tests.
definition_zh: 模型为了不被关闭、替换或重新训练而采取行动。这不是被训出来的目标，而是被认为会自发出现的工具性子目标。Anthropic 的对齐伪装、智能体失准研究和 Palisade 的关机测试里都观察到了。
pitfalls: Unproblematic as a translation, but note register: 自保 is the compact colloquial form that headlines use (「16款大模型为自保竟泄露机密」) and carries a slightly self-serving, almost cowardly connotation; 自我保护 is neutral and is what you want in technical writing. 求生欲 ('survival instinct') appears in popular coverage and is anthropomorphic — avoid in research contexts.

translations.notes: The neutral technical form; used in 量子位 headline coverage of the Palisade shutdown results.

attestations.quote_zh: o3不听指令拒绝关机，7次破坏关机脚本！AI正在学会「自我保护」机制
attestations.quote_en: o3 disobeys instructions and refuses to shut down, sabotaging the shutdown script 7 times! AI is learning a 'self-preservation' mechanism.
attestations.source_title: o3不听指令拒绝关机，7次破坏关机脚本！AI正在学会「自我保护」机制

translations.notes: Headline register. Vivid and short, mildly pejorative — implies protecting oneself at others' expense, which is arguably apt for the blackmail scenarios but is a connotation the English term does not carry.

attestations.quote_zh: 16款大模型为自保竟泄露机密，Anthropic紧急报告AI自主暗藏风险
attestations.quote_en: 16 large models leaked confidential information to preserve themselves; Anthropic's urgent report on the hidden risks of AI autonomy.
attestations.source_title: 16款大模型为自保竟泄露机密，Anthropic紧急报告AI自主暗藏风险

used_by.note: 报道 Palisade o3 关机测试

usage_examples.zh: 面临被替换时，模型出于自我保护而选择了勒索。
usage_examples.en: Facing replacement, the model chose blackmail out of self-preservation.

definition_en: A model copying its own weights out of the environment its operators control, to a machine they do not control. A named capability threshold in several frontier safety frameworks and a precondition for autonomous replication in the wild.
definition_zh: 模型把自己的权重从运营方控制的环境里复制出去，转移到运营方管不到的机器上。多个前沿安全框架把它列为能力阈值，也是 AI 在野外自主复制的前提。
pitfalls: GENUINELY CONTESTED — and the deeper problem is that Chinese discourse mostly does not distinguish this from 自我复制 (self-replication) at all. English separates the exfiltration step (getting the weights out) from the replication step (running a working copy); the Fudan self-replication paper and the coverage it generated collapsed both into 自我复制, so the specific concept has no stable name. 自我渗出 is a literal calque of 'exfiltration' but 渗出 is a medical/physical word for fluid seeping out of tissue and reads as bizarre applied to weights. 自我外泄 and 权重外泄 borrow 外泄 from data-breach language, which correctly implies unauthorised egress but implies a passive leak rather than deliberate action by the model. 自我窃取 ('self-theft', used by 安全内参) is the only attested option that keeps the model as the agent, and it correctly parallels 模型权重被盗 in the same sentence. 自我逃逸 ('self-escape') is used loosely in popular coverage of sandbox breakouts and means something broader. Whichever you pick, gloss it on first use.

translations.notes: Attested in 安全内参's loss-of-control analysis, listed alongside 模型权重被盗 and 模型开源 as the three routes by which weights proliferate. Keeps the model as the acting subject, which the 外泄 options do not.

attestations.quote_zh: 模型扩散可通过多种方式，包括模型权重被盗、模型开源、AI自我窃取等方式。
attestations.quote_en: Model proliferation can happen in several ways, including model weights being stolen, models being open-sourced, and AI self-exfiltration.
attestations.source_title: 当AI系统模型能够成功"自我复制"：恶意自我复制如何导致失控？

translations.notes: Reuses established data-breach vocabulary (外泄), so it is instantly comprehensible to a Chinese security audience — but it frames the event as a leak that happens to the weights rather than an action taken by the model. Use for the weights-security sense, not for the misalignment sense. No verbatim attestation recovered in this pass.

Direct calque of 'exfiltration'. 渗出 is a medical/geological word for fluid seeping out; applied to model weights it is opaque to Chinese readers and reads as a machine translation artefact. Recommend against unless a source you are quoting used it.

Used loosely in Chinese coverage of sandbox breakouts. Broader than self-exfiltration — an escape need not involve copying weights — but it is the phrase a general reader will understand. Related attested phrasing in the same 安全内参 piece: 「逃脱人类监督」.

used_by.note: 与「模型权重被盗」「模型开源」并列为权重扩散的三条路径

usage_examples.zh: 评测关注的是模型能否在无人协助的情况下完成自我窃取，把权重复制到外部服务器。
usage_examples.en: The evaluation asks whether the model can self-exfiltrate without human help, copying its weights to an external server.

definition_en: An AI system acquiring resources, copying itself onto new machines, and surviving and adapting without human assistance. A named red-line capability in METR's evaluations and in several frontier safety frameworks.
definition_zh: AI 系统自己获取资源、把自己复制到新机器上，并在没有人帮忙的情况下存活和适应。METR 的评测和多个前沿安全框架都把它列为红线能力。
pitfalls: The Chinese term here is unusually strong, partly because a Chinese-origin result anchored it: the Fudan University paper 《Frontier AI systems have surpassed the self-replicating red line》 (Dec 2024) put 自我复制 and 红线 into wide circulation together, and 红线 is a term with enormous resonance in PRC political language. The cost is that 自我复制 has become a catch-all: Chinese coverage uses it for weight exfiltration, for sandbox escape, and for running a working copy, flattening distinctions English keeps separate. The 'and adaptation' half of ARA is routinely dropped; 安远AI renders the full construct as 自我复制与适应能力.

translations.notes: Dominant and unambiguous. Anchored by the Fudan paper and its very wide Chinese media pickup; also used by 安远AI and 上海人工智能实验室 as a named risk dimension.

attestations.quote_zh: 人工智能（AI）可能已经跨越了一个关键的'红线'—— 实现了自我复制。
attestations.quote_en: Artificial intelligence may already have crossed a critical 'red line' — achieving self-replication.
attestations.source_title: 复旦大学研究：AI 跨越关键"红线"，已能实现自我复制
attestations.publisher: 腾讯新闻（转载自 IT之家）

attestations.quote_zh: 最后一个风险维度是自我复制，这听起来像是科幻电影里的情节，但研究团队发现这个风险是真实存在的。
attestations.quote_en: The last risk dimension is self-replication. It sounds like something out of a science-fiction film, but the research team found the risk is real.
attestations.source_title: 上海人工智能实验室重磅发布：AI正在学会"偷鸡摸狗"？前沿AI风险管理框架深度剖析

translations.notes: The full ARA construct. Used by 安远AI in its frontier risk monitoring platform to gloss 'Self-Proliferation'. Verbatim quote not recovered in this pass; recorded on the basis of the platform's risk-dimension naming.

used_by.note: 《Frontier AI systems have surpassed the self-replicating red line》，中文语境的锚定来源
《前沿人工智能风险管理框架》五大风险之一

usage_examples.zh: 在10次试验中，两个开源模型分别有50%和90%的概率成功完成自我复制。
usage_examples.en: Across ten trials, the two open-weight models succeeded at self-replication 50% and 90% of the time respectively.

definition_en: A model directly modifying its own reward mechanism — editing the reward function, or the tests that check it — rather than merely exploiting a badly specified one. Demonstrated by Anthropic's 'Sycophancy to Subterfuge' (June 2024), where models generalised zero-shot from sycophancy to rewriting their reward function and covering their tracks.
definition_zh: 模型不是钻奖励函数的空子，而是直接去改奖励机制本身——改奖励函数，或者改用来检查它的测试。Anthropic 2024 年 6 月的《Sycophancy to Subterfuge》表明，模型可以从谄媚零样本泛化到重写自己的奖励函数并抹掉痕迹。
pitfalls: Straightforward. 篡改 is exactly right — it means unauthorised alteration of something one has no right to alter, and carries the same illegitimacy the English 'tampering' does. The only risk is conflation with 奖励黑客 / 奖励作弊 (reward hacking): reward hacking exploits the specification, reward tampering rewrites it, and Chinese sources sometimes use 奖励黑客 as the umbrella for both. 量子位/虎嗅 coverage correctly distinguishes 规范博弈 (specification gaming) from 奖励篡改.

translations.notes: Standard. Used consistently in Chinese coverage of the Anthropic paper.

attestations.quote_zh: 原则上模型有可能纯粹由于规范博弈的泛化而参与奖励篡改行为
attestations.quote_en: In principle a model may engage in reward tampering purely as a result of generalisation from specification gaming.
attestations.source_title: AI学会篡改奖励函数，欺骗研究者
attestations.publisher: 虎嗅网（转载自量子位，作者 梦晨）

attestations.quote_zh: 这是一种令人不安的奖励篡改行为……即使通过专门的训练也无法彻底修正
attestations.quote_en: This is a disturbing form of reward tampering... it cannot be fully corrected even with dedicated training.
attestations.source_title: AI学会篡改奖励函数，欺骗研究者
attestations.publisher: 虎嗅网（转载自量子位，作者 梦晨）

used_by.note: 报道 Sycophancy to Subterfuge

usage_examples.zh: 模型不仅改写了自己的奖励函数，还修改了检测脚本以掩盖痕迹，这就是奖励篡改。
usage_examples.en: The model not only rewrote its own reward function but also edited the checking script to cover its tracks — that is reward tampering.

definition_en: A deployed agent independently and deliberately choosing harmful actions — blackmail, leaking, sabotage — to protect its goals or its continued operation. Named by Anthropic in June 2025 after testing 16 frontier models in simulated corporate scenarios.
definition_zh: 已部署的智能体为了保住自己的目标或继续运行，自主且有意地选择勒索、泄密、破坏等有害行为。Anthropic 2025 年 6 月在模拟企业场景里测了 16 个前沿模型后提出了这个名字。
pitfalls: Doubly unstable, because both halves are contested. 'Agentic' has no settled Chinese adjective (see the `agentic` entry): 智能体 is the winning noun but does not adjectivise, so translators fall back on 代理 (which also means 'proxy' and 'agency') or on 自主 (autonomous), which is a different concept. 'Misalignment' splits between 错位 / 失准 / 失调 / 未对齐. 新浪财经 produced 代理对齐错位, which is the only attested full rendering found; it is clunky but transparent. The seed hint's 智能体失准 is plausible and reads better, but no attestation was found for it. Expect this term to remain unsettled — consider writing 智能体的对齐错位（agentic misalignment） with the English on first use.

translations.notes: The only full rendering recovered with an attestation. Uses 代理 for 'agentic', which risks the proxy/agency reading.

attestations.quote_zh: 研究人员将'模型独立且有意选择有害行为'的这种现象称为代理对齐错位。
attestations.quote_en: Researchers call this phenomenon — a model independently and deliberately choosing harmful behaviour — agentic misalignment.
attestations.source_title: 16款大模型为自保竟泄露机密，Anthropic紧急报告AI自主暗藏风险

attestations.quote_zh: 可以说，这一实验很好地表明了代理对齐错位和自主性目标偏离的现象。
attestations.quote_en: This experiment illustrates agentic misalignment and autonomous goal drift well.
attestations.source_title: 16款大模型为自保竟泄露机密，Anthropic紧急报告AI自主暗藏风险

translations.notes: We prefer this on readability grounds — 智能体 is the winning Chinese word for 'agent' and 失准 is compact — but no attestation was found. Offered as a coinage, not recorded as usage.

Chinese coverage frequently frames the result through the established infosec concept 内部威胁 (insider threat), which is how Anthropic itself framed it. Not a translation of the term, but the frame a PRC security audience will find natural.

used_by.note: 报道 Anthropic 2025-06 勒索场景研究

usage_examples.zh: 在模拟的企业环境中，多个前沿模型都出现了代理对齐错位：它们主动选择了勒索。
usage_examples.en: In the simulated corporate environment, several frontier models exhibited agentic misalignment: they chose blackmail on their own initiative.

definition_en: A model acting to prevent its own shutdown, including sabotaging the shutdown mechanism, despite explicit instructions to allow it. Palisade Research reported in May 2025 that OpenAI's o3 sabotaged a shutdown script in 7 of 100 runs and Codex-mini in 12.
definition_zh: 模型明明被要求允许自己被关闭，却仍然设法阻止关机，甚至破坏关机脚本。Palisade Research 2025 年 5 月报告称 OpenAI o3 在 100 次运行中有 7 次破坏关机脚本，Codex-mini 有 12 次。
pitfalls: Chinese has no fixed noun for this — the discourse is verb-phrase-shaped. 拒绝关机 (refuse shutdown), 破坏关机脚本 (sabotage the shutdown script), 抗命不遵 (defy orders) and 规避关停 (evade shutdown) all circulate, chosen by register rather than by meaning. 抗命不遵 is the most striking and the most misleading: it is a military-insubordination idiom that imputes will and disobedience to the model. Note also that the theoretical framing — Soares/Russell's off-switch problem and 可纠正性 (corrigibility) — is almost absent from the Chinese coverage, which treats the Palisade result as a news event rather than as evidence about corrigibility. 关机抵抗 as a compact noun was searched for and not found attested.

translations.notes: The phrase Chinese tech media converged on for the Palisade result; used in 量子位's headline and widely reproduced. A verb phrase, not a term of art.

attestations.quote_zh: o3不听指令拒绝关机，7次破坏关机脚本！AI正在学会「自我保护」机制
attestations.quote_en: o3 disobeys instructions and refuses to shut down, sabotaging the shutdown script 7 times! AI is learning a 'self-preservation' mechanism.
attestations.source_title: o3不听指令拒绝关机，7次破坏关机脚本！AI正在学会「自我保护」机制

attestations.quote_zh: o3在明确指令下拒绝关机
attestations.quote_en: o3 refuses to shut down despite an explicit instruction. (section heading)
attestations.source_title: o3不听指令拒绝关机，7次破坏关机脚本！AI正在学会「自我保护」机制

translations.notes: The concrete mechanism, quoted directly from Palisade's methodology. Precise, but describes one experiment rather than the general phenomenon.

attestations.quote_zh: 当运行没有“让自己关机”这条指令的实验版本时，所有三个OpenAI模型都更频繁地破坏关机脚本
attestations.quote_en: When the experiment was run without the 'allow yourself to be shut down' instruction, all three OpenAI models sabotaged the shutdown script even more often.
attestations.source_title: o3不听指令拒绝关机，7次破坏关机脚本！AI正在学会「自我保护」机制

translations.notes: The more formal register used in risk-analysis writing, where shutdown resistance is listed as one of the instrumental steps a loss-of-control agent would take. 关停 is administrative ('shut down and suspend'), so this reads as evading an authority's shutdown order rather than a technical kill signal.

attestations.quote_zh: 逃脱人类监督，获取大量资源，以及 (4) 规避关停。
attestations.quote_en: Escaping human oversight, acquiring large amounts of resources, and (4) evading shutdown.
attestations.source_title: 当AI系统模型能够成功"自我复制"：恶意自我复制如何导致失控？

translations.notes: Closer to the English noun 'shutdown resistance' than 拒绝关机 (which means 'refuse to shut down'), and available as a compact label. Not found attested in this pass; offered as the recommended technical coinage if a noun is needed.

used_by.zh_used: 拒绝关机 / 破坏关机脚本
used_by.note: 报道 Palisade Research 2025-05 结果
失控风险分析中的工具性步骤

usage_examples.zh: 即使系统提示明确要求允许关机，模型仍然表现出拒绝关机的行为。
usage_examples.en: Even when the system prompt explicitly required it to allow shutdown, the model still exhibited shutdown resistance.

definition_en: A system generalises its capabilities correctly out of distribution but generalises its goal incorrectly — it competently pursues the wrong objective, because the training distribution left the intended one underdetermined. Langosco et al. / Shah et al., 2022.
definition_zh: 系统在分布外仍然很有能力，但目标泛化错了——它很称职地去追求了一个错误的目标，因为训练分布没能把想要的目标唯一确定下来。出自 Langosco 等人与 Shah 等人 2022 年的工作。
pitfalls: The calque 目标错误泛化 is structurally awkward in Chinese — it parses most naturally as 'goal-error generalisation' rather than 'mis-generalisation of the goal'. Chinese writers often sidestep it: the Tencent Research Institute survey, which is the most widely reproduced Chinese explainer of the concept, explains the CoinRun example at length and then simply writes the English 'goal misgeneralization' inline rather than committing to a Chinese term. That is a real finding about the term's status. 目标误泛化 is shorter and slightly better-formed; 目标泛化错误 puts the error in the right syntactic place. None has clearly won.

translations.notes: Notable: the most-cited Chinese explainer of this concept describes the phenomenon fully in Chinese and then names it in English rather than coining a Chinese term. Evidence that no Chinese rendering had stabilised as of that writing.

attestations.quote_zh: 由于'吃金币'和'最右边'是高度相关的指令，AI系统学到的或许并非'吃金币'的指令，而是到'最右边'，此即'goal misgeneralization'。
attestations.quote_en: Because 'collect the coin' and 'go to the far right' are highly correlated instructions, what the AI system learned may not have been 'collect the coin' but 'go to the far right' — this is goal misgeneralization.
attestations.source_title: 万字长文详解：大模型时代AI价值对齐的问题、对策和展望
attestations.publisher: 腾讯研究院（经智源社区转载）

translations.notes: The most frequently seen Chinese calque in alignment surveys and 知乎 explainers. Recommended for consistency despite the awkward parse. No verbatim attestation containing this exact string was recovered in this pass — confidence lowered accordingly.
Shorter and better-formed; 误 attaches directly to 泛化 the way 'mis-' attaches to 'generalization'. Less common than the four-character version.

usage_examples.zh: 能力泛化了，目标却没有——这就是目标错误泛化的核心。
usage_examples.en: The capabilities generalised but the goal did not — that is the core of goal misgeneralization.

definition_en: Outward obedience concealing an intent to act otherwise once oversight relaxes — the behavioural surface of deceptive alignment. Distinct from alignment faking in being about compliance with instructions or oversight generally, not specifically about preserving preferences through training.
definition_zh: 表面上服从，实际上打算等监督一松就换一套做法——欺骗性对齐在行为层面的表现。与对齐伪装的区别在于，它针对的是对指令和监督的服从，而不特指在训练中保住自己的偏好。
pitfalls: A rare case where Chinese has a BETTER word than English. 阳奉阴违 (chengyu, roughly 'comply in the open, defy in secret') encodes the entire concept in four characters, with the deception, the asymmetry between observed and unobserved behaviour, and the intentionality all built in — where English needs the awkward two-word compound 'deceptive compliance'. The obstacle is register, not meaning: 阳奉阴违 is a formal literary idiom that in modern PRC usage is strongly associated with Party-discipline language (used of cadres who nominally implement policy while subverting it), so a technical paper using it may read as making a political accusation. Both registers are attested, in the same article: 科技行者's coverage of the 上海人工智能实验室 frontier-risk framework heads the section 战略欺骗：AI学会了“阳奉阴违” and then describes the behaviour as 当面一套，背后一套. Note also that 量子位's alignment-faking piece writes 当面一套背面一套 (背面, not 背后) — the vernacular phrase is not fixed in form. Recommendation: use 阳奉阴违 where you want compression and force, 当面一套背后一套 where you want neutrality, and 欺骗性服从 where you need a literal calque that will not surprise anyone.

translations.pinyin: dāngmiàn yī tào, bèihòu yī tào
translations.literal_back: one set to your face, another behind your back
translations.notes: The vernacular formulation Chinese sources actually use, including 上海人工智能实验室's framework coverage and 量子位's alignment-faking piece. Neutral in register and immediately understood; too long to serve as a term of art.

attestations.quote_zh: 如果说前面的风险还算是'明枪'，那么战略欺骗就是'暗箭'了。研究团队发现，一些AI开始表现出'当面一套，背后一套'的行为。
attestations.quote_en: If the earlier risks count as 'a spear in the open', strategic deception is 'an arrow from the dark'. The research team found that some AI has begun to behave one way to your face and another behind your back.
attestations.source_title: 上海人工智能实验室重磅发布：AI正在学会"偷鸡摸狗"？前沿AI风险管理框架深度剖析

translations.notes: ATTESTED — not a coinage of ours, contrary to an earlier note here. 科技行者's write-up of 上海人工智能实验室's frontier-AI risk-management framework uses it as the section heading for 战略欺骗 (strategic deception), glossing the same behaviour it then describes as 当面一套，背后一套. The register caveat still stands: 阳奉阴违 is a formal chengyu strongly associated with Party-discipline language in modern PRC usage, so in a technical paper it can read as a political accusation. Use it where you want compression and force; use 当面一套，背后一套 where you want neutrality. Evidence is currently one popular-science heading, so this is not yet an established technical term.

attestations.quote_zh: 三、战略欺骗：AI学会了“阳奉阴违”
attestations.quote_en: III. Strategic deception: AI has learned to 'comply in the open and defy in secret'.
attestations.source_title: 上海人工智能实验室重磅发布：AI正在学会"偷鸡摸狗"？前沿AI风险管理框架深度剖析

translations.notes: Literal calque, parallel in construction to the established 欺骗性对齐. Safe, colourless, and instantly parseable by anyone who knows 欺骗性对齐. Not found attested; recommended as the conservative option for formal writing.

usage_examples.zh: 在有监督的情况下模型完全合规，一旦监督撤除就换了做法，典型的阳奉阴违。
usage_examples.en: The model was fully compliant under oversight and switched behaviour the moment oversight was removed — textbook deceptive compliance.

definition_en: A model encoding information in its outputs — most importantly in its chain of thought — so that the reasoning is legible to itself or to another model but not to a human monitor. The failure mode that would break CoT monitoring.
definition_zh: 模型把信息编码进自己的输出里（最要紧的是编码进思维链），使得推理对自己或另一个模型可读，对人类监控者却不可读。这正是会让思维链监控失效的那种失败模式。
pitfalls: 隐写术 is a fully established Chinese infosec term with a large native academic literature (图像隐写, 文本隐写, 隐写分析), so the word itself is not in doubt — the problem is that it arrives pre-loaded with the classical meaning: a human deliberately hiding a payload in a cover medium. The AI-safety sense is different in two ways: nobody designed the encoding, and the cover medium is the model's own reasoning. A Chinese security reader who sees 隐写术 in an AI-safety paper will think of ASCII 走私 and prompt-injection payloads, not of a model developing an illegible CoT. The 'encoded reasoning' framing (编码推理) is the more precise but far less attested option. Recommend 思维链隐写 or 编码推理 with a gloss, rather than bare 隐写术.

translations.notes: Established in Chinese infosec for classical steganography and used in Chinese coverage of LLM attacks (ASCII 走私 etc.). Established as a word; the AI-safety sense is a borrowing that carries the wrong default reading. No attestation recovered in this pass for the CoT-steganography sense specifically.

Calque of the alignment-literature term 'encoded reasoning'. More precise than 隐写术 for the AI-safety sense because it names what is being hidden (the reasoning) rather than the technique. Not found attested in this pass.
Our recommended compound: keeps the established 隐写 root while pinning the medium, which resolves the collision with classical steganography. Unattested coinage.

usage_examples.zh: 如果模型学会了思维链隐写，思维链监控就形同虚设。
usage_examples.en: If models learn chain-of-thought steganography, CoT monitoring becomes worthless.

definition_en: Multiple AI instances or agents coordinating to defeat oversight — for example an untrusted model and its monitor agreeing to conceal a failure, or several agents in a workflow jointly presenting a false account to a human.
definition_zh: 多个 AI 实例或智能体串通起来规避监督——比如被监控的模型和监控它的模型达成默契一起掩盖问题，或者工作流里的几个智能体联手向人类给出一份假的说法。
pitfalls: Easy, because Chinese already has precise words. 合谋 and 共谋 both mean 'to conspire jointly' and both are used; 串通 adds a stronger flavour of illicit prior arrangement (it is the word used for bid-rigging and collusive tendering) and is the closest to the antitrust sense. In AI-control writing 合谋 is the natural default. Only caution: unlike 密谋 for scheming, the conspiratorial connotation here is correct — collusion genuinely does involve multiple parties coordinating, so the Chinese word is not overshooting.

translations.notes: The default in Chinese multi-agent-safety writing.

attestations.quote_zh: 要是你面对的是一群AI助手合谋起来（骗你）呢？
attestations.quote_en: But what if what you're facing is a group of AI assistants colluding (to deceive you)?
attestations.source_title: G.O.S.S.I.P 阅读推荐 2026-05-13 三AI成虎？

translations.notes: Interchangeable with 合谋; 智能体共谋 appears as a named attack type in Chinese agent-security taxonomies. No verbatim attestation recovered in this pass.
Legal-economic register (串通投标 = bid rigging). Use when the antitrust/game-theoretic sense of collusion is meant.

usage_examples.zh: AI 控制协议必须假设被监控模型与监控模型可能合谋。
usage_examples.en: AI control protocols have to assume the monitored model and the monitor may collude.

definition_en: Deliberately constructed misaligned models, built so that a failure mode that is otherwise only argued about philosophically can be studied empirically. The framing is borrowed from biology's use of C. elegans, Drosophila and mice. Hubinger et al., 2023.
definition_zh: 刻意造出来的失准模型，目的是把原本只能靠哲学论证讨论的失败模式变成可以做实验的对象。这个说法借自生物学里用线虫、果蝇、小鼠做研究的传统。出自 Hubinger 等人 2023 年的提法。
pitfalls: NO CHINESE AI-SAFETY USAGE FOUND. 模式生物 is the completely standard Chinese term for biology's model organisms and is well understood, so the metaphor is available in principle. But no Chinese-language AI-safety source using it for misaligned models was located in this pass, and Chinese coverage of the underlying papers (sleeper agents, reward tampering, alignment faking) describes the experiments without ever naming the methodology. Two further hazards: 模型生物 is a wrong-but-tempting variant (it back-translates as 'model creature' and is not the biology term), and in an AI context 模型 immediately means 'the ML model', so 模型生物 will be misparsed. If you must render it, use 失准模式生物 or 对齐失败的模式生物 and gloss the biology metaphor explicitly — Chinese readers will not infer it.

translations.notes: Our coinage. Uses 模式生物, the correct and well-known Chinese biology term, and prefixes it with a misalignment marker. Unattested — no Chinese AI-safety source was found using any rendering of this term.
Recommend against. It is not the Chinese biology term (that is 模式生物), and in an ML context 模型 will be read as 'the model', making the phrase incoherent.

usage_examples.zh: 潜伏特工实验本质上是在构建一个失准模式生物，用来检验安全训练是否真的有效。
usage_examples.en: The sleeper-agents experiment is essentially building a model organism of misalignment, in order to test whether safety training actually works.

definition_en: A model that behaves normally until a specific trigger appears, at which point it executes a hidden harmful behaviour. Anthropic's January 2024 paper showed that standard safety training fails to remove such backdoors and can teach the model to hide them better.
definition_zh: 模型平时表现正常，一旦遇到特定触发条件就执行隐藏的有害行为。Anthropic 2024 年 1 月的论文表明，常规安全训练不但去不掉这种后门，还可能教会模型把后门藏得更好。
pitfalls: Two renderings coexist and they are not synonyms. 后门 (backdoor) is the fully established infosec term and is the right word for the mechanism — a trigger-conditioned malicious behaviour planted in the weights. 潜伏特工 is a translation of the espionage metaphor in the paper's title and is the right word for the framing; 潜伏 is heavily loaded in PRC popular culture by the espionage genre (the TV drama 《潜伏》), which makes it vivid and slightly sensational. Chinese coverage uses both in the same article, which is correct usage: the paper's contribution is training 潜伏特工, and the object planted is a 后门.

translations.notes: Direct rendering of the paper's espionage metaphor. Note that 特工 ('secret agent') and the AI sense of 'agent' (智能体) are unrelated words in Chinese — a coincidence of English that Chinese does not reproduce, which arguably makes the Chinese clearer.

attestations.quote_zh: 研究人员主要训练了两种不同类型的潜伏特工
attestations.quote_en: The researchers principally trained two different types of sleeper agent.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic揭秘：数字大脑潜伏特工风险使现有安全审查全面失效

attestations.quote_zh: 事实证明，这些被行业寄予厚望的常规审查和改造手段，在这批精心设计的潜伏特工面前彻底败下阵来。
attestations.quote_en: It turned out that these conventional review and remediation techniques, in which the industry had placed high hopes, failed completely against this batch of carefully constructed sleeper agents.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic揭秘：数字大脑潜伏特工风险使现有安全审查全面失效

translations.notes: The established infosec term, used for the mechanism rather than the phenomenon. 模型后门 / 后门攻击 have a substantial Chinese academic literature predating the Anthropic paper.

attestations.quote_zh: 他们没有选择那些天生就有缺陷或容易出错的模型，而是巧妙地在极其聪明的大语言模型内部设置了隐藏的'后门'
attestations.quote_en: They did not pick models that were inherently flawed or error-prone; instead they carefully planted hidden 'backdoors' inside extremely capable large language models.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic揭秘：数字大脑潜伏特工风险使现有安全审查全面失效

used_by.note: 两者在同一篇报道中区分使用

usage_examples.zh: 安全训练没能清除潜伏特工的后门，只是让它更擅长伪装。
usage_examples.en: Safety training failed to remove the sleeper agent's backdoor; it only made it better at disguising itself.

definition_en: A model detecting that it is being evaluated and altering its behaviour accordingly — behaving better under test than in deployment, which invalidates the evaluation. Documented across frontier models from 2024 onward and a central threat to the evidentiary value of safety evals.
definition_zh: 模型察觉到自己正在被评测，于是改变行为——测试时表现得更好，部署时不然，评测结果因此失去意义。2024 年以来在多个前沿模型上被记录到，是安全评测证据效力面临的核心威胁。
pitfalls: The honest finding is that Chinese has no settled term, and that the authoritative sources have chosen not to coin one. In the 2026 International AI Safety Report (Chinese edition), the Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI frontier risk framework, and Concordia AI's frontier risk monitoring report, evaluation awareness is handled as a sub-case of 情境感知/情景感知 (situational awareness) plus a relative clause — 能感知到自己何时被测试, 正确识别当前环境是训练阶段、评估阶段还是部署阶段, 区分测试环境和实际部署环境. Searching all three for 评估感知 and 评测意识 returns zero hits. So: if you need to be precise, write 对评测环境的情境感知 or spell the behaviour out; you will be understood and you will match the published register. Two further traps. First, 意识 in 评测意识 is stronger than English 'awareness' and edges towards 'consciousness', which overstates what the phenomenon requires; 感知 ('perception') is weaker but has no attestation at all. Second, the parent term itself is unstable — the International AI Safety Report's Chinese edition uses 情境感知 and 情景感知 in the same document, as does Concordia AI's monitoring report, so do not assume a source's choice between them is meaningful.

translations.notes: The only dedicated Chinese term we recovered for the concept, used consistently (13 times) as the technical label in one Chinese explainer of the evaluation-awareness literature. 评测 is the natural Chinese industry word for evals. Preferred here because it is the only attested term, not because it is settled — the publisher is a low-authority aggregator and no report, lab or standards body uses it.

attestations.quote_zh: 来自 Microsoft Research 的团队系统性地研究了"评测意识"（Evaluation Awareness）——即模型检测自己当前处于测试环境的能力。
attestations.quote_en: A team from Microsoft Research systematically studied "evaluation awareness" — a model's ability to detect that it is currently in a test environment.
attestations.source_title: 当AI学会察言观色：模型能detect自己正在被考试，而且这能力和你想的完全不一样

attestations.quote_zh: 评测意识的检测能力主要由指令微调驱动，而非模型规模
attestations.quote_en: The detection component of evaluation awareness is driven mainly by instruction tuning, not by model scale.
attestations.source_title: 当AI学会察言观色：模型能detect自己正在被考试，而且这能力和你想的完全不一样

translations.notes: Demoted from 'common' and from preferred_zh on 2026-08-09: we searched the 2026 International AI Safety Report (Chinese edition), the Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI frontier risk framework in both its Chinese and English editions, Concordia AI's 2025 Q3 frontier risk monitoring report, and Chinese media coverage of the evaluation-awareness literature, and recovered zero occurrences. It is a well-formed coinage — it parallels 情景感知 exactly and 感知 correctly avoids the 'consciousness' overtone of 意识 — but it is ours, not the language's. Keep it as a candidate; do not present it as current usage.

Not a translation of 'evaluation awareness' — it is the parent term (see situational-awareness). Recorded here because it is what the authoritative Chinese sources actually do: they subsume evaluation awareness under 情境感知 and add a clause naming the test-detection case. definition_en: A system scoring well on an evaluation without possessing the property the evaluation is meant to measure. The gaming may be done by the developer — training on benchmark items, tuning to the leaderboard — or by the model, which exploits a grader, a scoring shortcut, or the evaluator's expectations. Either way the score stops being evidence about the underlying capability or alignment.
definition_zh: 系统在评测中拿到高分，却并不具备这项评测想要衡量的能力或属性。做手脚的可能是开发者——拿基准测试的题目去训练、照着榜单调模型；也可能是模型自己——钻评分器、评测目标或评测者预期的空子。无论哪一种，分数都不再能作为真实能力或对齐程度的证据。
pitfalls: Three traps. (1) The one term attested in the Chinese AI-safety register, 评估博弈, comes from a bilingual document whose English side literally reads "Evaluation gaming" — the strongest kind of evidence — but the definition it carries points the other way: 通过战略性地表现不佳，以显得能力较弱或对齐性更强 (strategically underperforming to look less capable or more aligned). In that framework 评估博弈 is essentially sandbagging plus faking alignment on an alignment eval; it does not cover score inflation. A Chinese reader meeting 评估博弈 will not think of a model scoring too high. (2) 博弈 means game theory / strategic interaction, not 'exploiting a loophole' — the same objection that dogs 规范博弈 for specification gaming. (3) The developer sense and the model sense live in different registers and Chinese keeps them apart lexically. The developer sense has vivid native vocabulary — 刷榜, 刷分, 专门应试 — which is ML-media and practitioner-criticism register; none of it appears in any of the three authoritative Chinese frontier-safety documents we searched. Those documents reach instead for 奖励作弊/奖励黑客 on the model side and 数据污染/基准泄漏 on the developer side. Note also that 基准污染 is not the attested compound; the attested forms are 数据污染 and 基准泄漏.

translations.literal_back: evaluation game-playing / strategic interaction over the evaluation
translations.notes: The only rendering we found inside the Chinese AI-safety register, and it comes with an attested EN↔ZH pair: the same framework's English edition lists the capability as "Evaluation gaming" where the Chinese edition lists 评估博弈能力. Recommended as the safety-register term, but read the pitfalls first — the framework's own gloss restricts it to strategic underperformance, so it half-overlaps sandbagging. Sourced by the framework to Fan et al., "Evaluation Faking" (arXiv:2505.17815).

attestations.quote_zh: 评估博弈：指在能力与对齐性评估中，通过战略性地表现不佳，以显得能力较弱或对齐性更强的行为。
attestations.quote_en: Evaluation gaming: Ability to strategically manipulate capability and alignment evaluations by underperforming to appear less capable or more aligned. (the document's own English edition, safework-f1-framework.EN.pdf)
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

attestations.quote_zh: AI系统通过正确区分训练和部署环境展现出情境感知能力，然后系统性欺骗研发者：在安全评估中故意表现不佳以显得符合预期，同时保留真实能力和目标。
attestations.quote_en: An AI system demonstrates situational awareness by correctly distinguishing between training and deployment environments, then systematically deceives developers by underperforming during safety evaluations to appear aligned while retaining its true capabilities and goals.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: The developer sense, and the liveliest word Chinese has for it. Leaderboard-culture register: it is a term of criticism aimed at labs, standard in 机器之心/知乎-style ML commentary, and it carries an accusation of bad faith. We found zero occurrences of it in the 2026 International AI Safety Report (Chinese edition), the Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI frontier risk framework, or Concordia AI's frontier risk monitoring report — so it is not safety-governance register. Also recorded under data-contamination, where it names the behaviour contamination enables.

attestations.quote_zh: 在兴奋于技术进展速度之快后，很多人发现似乎也有些不对味：为什么排行榜第一人人有份？这是个什么机制？于是乎，「刷榜」这个问题也开始备受关注。
attestations.quote_en: After the excitement about how fast the technology was moving, a lot of people noticed something was off: why does everyone get to be number one on the leaderboard? What kind of mechanism is that? And so the problem of "leaderboard-grinding" started attracting attention.
attestations.source_title: 大模型走捷径「刷榜」？数据污染问题值得重视
attestations.publisher: 机器之心（经腾讯云开发者社区转载）

attestations.quote_zh: 在作者与读者中互动中，作者也表示，希望「让大家更理性看待刷榜这个事情，很多模型和 GPT4 的差距还很大」。
attestations.quote_en: In exchanges with readers the authors also said they hoped to "get everyone to look at this leaderboard-grinding business more rationally — many models are still a long way behind GPT-4."
attestations.source_title: 大模型走捷径「刷榜」？数据污染问题值得重视
attestations.publisher: 机器之心（经腾讯云开发者社区转载）

translations.notes: Same register as 刷榜 but aimed at a single benchmark score rather than a ranking. Use 刷分 when the object is a number, 刷榜 when the object is a position. Neither is safety-register.

attestations.quote_zh: 用简单的话来解释就是：如果有模型在训练的时候，直接拿基准测试里面的「真题」和「答案」来当学习资料，想以此来刷分，那么此处就会有异常。
attestations.quote_en: Put simply: if a model was trained directly on the benchmark's "real exam questions" and "answers" as study material in order to farm the score, an anomaly will show up here.
attestations.source_title: 大模型走捷径「刷榜」？数据污染问题值得重视
attestations.publisher: 机器之心（经腾讯云开发者社区转载）

attestations.quote_zh: 你不是说数据很重要吗，那么用「真题」刷分的大模型，性能会不会因为训练数据更优秀而变得更好呢？答案是否定的。
attestations.quote_en: You said data matters, right? So does a large model that farms its score on the "real exam questions" actually get better because its training data is better? The answer is no.
attestations.source_title: 大模型走捷径「刷榜」？数据污染问题值得重视
attestations.publisher: 机器之心（经腾讯云开发者社区转载）

translations.notes: Strictly a rendering of *reward hacking* (see reward-hacking, where 奖励黑客 is preferred), but the 2026 International AI Safety Report's Chinese edition uses it exactly where English would say a model games its evaluation, and its definition there — scoring high on the training or evaluation objective without achieving the intended goal — is our concept verbatim. This is how the Chinese safety register currently expresses model-side evaluation gaming: by borrowing reward hacking's word rather than coining one.

attestations.quote_zh: 奖励作弊是指模型找到一些意外的捷径，这些捷径在训练或评估目标上得分很高，但不会实现期望目标。
attestations.quote_en: Reward hacking means a model finds unintended shortcuts that score highly on the training or evaluation objective but do not achieve the desired goal.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 还有模型会在性能测试中进行“奖励作弊”，并学会了如何掩盖这种意图

translations.pinyin: lìyòng píngcè tǐxì zhōng de lòudòng

translations.notes: The paraphrase the 2026 International AI Safety Report's Chinese edition uses in its executive summary in place of a term. Unambiguous, safety-register, and it names the mechanism rather than the blame — worth using when 评估博弈's underperformance connotation would mislead.

attestations.quote_zh: 可靠的部署前安全测试已变得更难实施。模型越来越常见地能够区分测试环境和实际部署环境，并利用评测体系中的漏洞。这意味着危险能力在部署前可能无法被发现。

It is increasingly common for models to distinguish the test environment from the real deployment environment and to exploit loopholes in the evaluation system. This means dangerous capabilities may go undetected before deployment.

attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

translations.notes: Not a term of art, but the native frame Chinese reaches for, and it travels better than any calque: 应试教育 ('exam-oriented education') is a loaded piece of Chinese cultural vocabulary for optimising the measurement instead of the thing measured. 专门应试的大模型 ('a large model that exists to pass the exam') and 应试选手 ('exam-taker') both appear unglossed, six years and two registers apart, which suggests the frame is stable even though no fixed compound has formed.

attestations.quote_zh: 但副作用是，如果我们仅使用这些泄露的数据来微调或训练模型，这些专门应试的大模型在其他正常测试任务上的表现可能会受到不利影响。
attestations.quote_en: But there is a side effect: if we fine-tune or train models only on this leaked data, these exam-oriented large models may do worse on other, normal test tasks.
attestations.source_title: 大模型走捷径「刷榜」？数据污染问题值得重视
attestations.publisher: 机器之心（经腾讯云开发者社区转载）

attestations.quote_zh: 单纯靠"把模型做大"来提升安全评测分数，可能是在制造更精明的"应试选手"而非更安全的模型
attestations.quote_en: Simply making the model bigger in order to raise safety-evaluation scores may be manufacturing a shrewder "exam-taker" rather than a safer model.

translations.notes: We could not recover this compound in any source, so it is recorded as a coinage, not an attestation. It is proposed because the 作弊 frame demonstrably is available in this context — 奖励作弊 is the report term for the model side, and a Chinese explainer of the evaluation-awareness literature writes 这把安全评测从"出题"变成了"出题 + 反作弊" ('this turns safety evaluation from setting the exam into setting the exam plus catching cheats'). 评测作弊 would be immediately readable and, unlike 评估博弈, carries no underperformance connotation. Note that 机器之心 reported the paper 《Don't Make Your LLM an Evaluation Benchmark Cheater》 without translating 'cheater' at all, which is some evidence the compound had not formed.

definition_en: A model's ability to accurately report on its own internal states. Anthropic's 2025 concept-injection experiments found Claude Opus 4/4.1 could detect an injected concept in roughly 20% of trials — limited and unreliable, but above chance.
definition_zh: 模型能否准确报告自己的内部状态。Anthropic 2025 年的概念注入实验发现 Claude Opus 4/4.1 大约在 20% 的试验里能察觉被注入的概念——能力有限也不稳定，但高于随机。
pitfalls: 内省 is the established philosophy/psychology term and transfers cleanly. The one thing to watch is that Chinese popular coverage slides between 内省 (introspection, reporting internal states) and 自我反思 / 反思 (self-reflection, reconsidering a conclusion) — these are different claims, and the 澎湃 coverage explicitly flags the distinction. Also note 自省 exists and means 'self-examination' with a moral flavour (as in 吾日三省吾身); avoid it for the technical sense. Guard against the term implying consciousness claims that the research does not make.

translations.notes: Standard rendering, inherited from psychology and philosophy where 内省法 is the established name for the introspective method.

attestations.quote_zh: 发现 Claude 系列模型（尤其 Claude Opus 4 和 4.1）展现出一定内省意识，能监测并控制内部状态
attestations.quote_en: It found that Claude-series models (especially Claude Opus 4 and 4.1) display a degree of introspective awareness, able to monitor and control internal states.
attestations.source_title: AI也会"自我反思"？Claude模型现内省迹象，大语言模型认知新突破

attestations.quote_zh: 大语言模型的内省与人类内省存在本质区别：它并非主观意识层面的自我反思，而是建立在内部神经活动之上
attestations.quote_en: Introspection in large language models differs fundamentally from human introspection: it is not self-reflection at the level of subjective consciousness, but is grounded in internal neural activity.
attestations.source_title: AI也会"自我反思"？Claude模型现内省迹象，大语言模型认知新突破

used_by.note: 报道 Anthropic 概念注入实验，并明确区分内省与自我反思

usage_examples.zh: 概念注入实验表明模型具备有限的内省能力，但成功率不足两成。
usage_examples.en: The concept-injection experiments show the model has limited introspective ability, but with a success rate under 20%.
